description: This file defines the ScreenAuthorizationSubscriber class, which is an event subscriber in the OrangeHRM system responsible for handling authorization checks for screen access and managing Forbidden exceptions in the Symfony-based event lifecycle.

classes.name: ScreenAuthorizationSubscriber
classes.description: A Symfony event subscriber that manages access control for screens within OrangeHRM by checking permissions and handling forbidden exceptions during controller events and exceptions.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Registers event handlers for controller and exception events in Symfony's kernel event system.

methods.name: onControllerEvent
methods.description: Performs authorization checks during the controller event, skipping public controllers and logout actions. Throws ForbiddenException if permissions are insufficient.

methods.name: onExceptionEvent
methods.description: Handles ForbiddenException during exception events by forwarding to a dedicated forbidden page controller.

methods.name: getControllerInstance
methods.description: Retrieves the controller instance from the Symfony ControllerEvent.
